jobs.title: Security Officer - Great Pay, Benefits & Varied Shifts
jobs.description:
ADM Security Solutions is a division of Admiral Security Services, providing security services across numerous locations. The selected candidate will perform various security duties, including access control and patrols, while adhering to site post orders.

The role requires standing for long periods, ability to work in varying weather, and reliable transportation. Great pay, health and life insurance, 401(K), and paid vacation are offered.
